description: HbA1c fell from 8.9% to about 7.1% after metformin was started and increased.
One-off high potassium (about 5.8 mmol/L); back in range at the next test.
Sudden eGFR drop to about 51 (below range) after gastroenteritis; partly recovered by month 21.
HbA1c rose again from about 7.0% to 8.4% between months 15 and 24.
HbA1c back to about 7.0% after empagliflozin was added.
LDL fell from about 3.3 to 2.0 mmol/L after atorvastatin was started.
LDL fell from 4.6 to about 3.2 mmol/L after atorvastatin 20 mg was started.
ALT rose above range (about 58 U/L) after the atorvastatin dose increase.
ALT peaked at about 71 U/L; AST also above range.
ALT back in range (about 33 U/L) after switching to rosuvastatin; LDL stayed controlled.
TSH high (about 9.8 mIU/L) and Free T4 low before treatment.
TSH back in range (about 2.4) after dose increases to 100 microgram.
TSH jumped to about 7.6 after a year of stable results, after starting calcium.
TSH back in range (about 3.0) after separating calcium and levothyroxine.
